arxiv-2007-08274.title: Asymptotic Enumeration and Limit Laws for Multisets: the Subexponential Case
arxiv-2007-08274.creator: Konstantinos Panagiotou, Leon Ramzews
arxiv-2007-08274.description: Abstract For a given combinatorial class 𝒞 {\mathcal{C}} we study the class 𝒢 = Mset ​ ( 𝒞 ) {\mathcal{G}}=\text{{Mset}}({\mathcal{C}}) satisfying the multiset construction, that is, any object in 𝒢 {\mathcal{G}} is uniquely determined by a set of 𝒞 {\mathcal{C}} -objects paired with their multiplicities.

arxiv-2103-11332.title: AdaptSum: Towards Low-Resource Domain Adaptation for Abstractive Summarization
arxiv-2103-11332.creator: Tiezheng Yu, Zihan Liu, Pascale FungCenter for Artificial Intelligence Research (CAiRE)Department of Electronic and Computer EngineeringThe Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Clear Water Bay, Hong Kong {tyuah,zliucr}@connect.ust.hk , pascale@ece.ust.hk
arxiv-2103-11332.description: Abstract State-of-the-art abstractive summarization models generally rely on extensive labeled data, which lowers their generalization ability on domains where such data are not available. In this paper, we present a study of domain adaptation for the abstractive summarization task across six diverse target domains in a low-resource setting.

arxiv-2105-04062.title: Approximate Fréchet Mean for Data Sets of Sparse Graphs
arxiv-2105-04062.creator: Daniel Ferguson, François G. Meyer
arxiv-2105-04062.description: Abstract To characterize the location (mean, median) of a set of graphs, one needs a notion of centrality that is adapted to metric spaces, since graph sets are not Euclidean spaces. A standard approach is to consider the Fréchet mean.

arxiv-2112-08769.title: Impurity metallic conduction below the critical concentration of Metal-Insulator Transition in Fe 1-x Co x Si
arxiv-2112-08769.creator: M. Krishnan, V. Ganesan
arxiv-2112-08769.description: Abstract Analysis on very detailed measurements of resistivity ( ρ \rho ) and thermoelectric power (S) of magnetic impurity (Co) substituted iron silicide (FeSi) has been presented in this report. The impurity valence electrons of Co dominate the whole physical properties at low temperatures below 35 K, below the critical concentration x c .

arxiv-2301-13806.title: Cavity-enhanced excitation of a quantum dot in the picosecond regime
arxiv-2301-13806.creator: Alisa Javadi, Natasha Tomm, Nadia O. Antoniadis, Alistair J. Brash, Rüdiger Schott, Sascha R. Valentin, Andreas D. Wieck, Arne Ludwig, Richard J. Warburton
arxiv-2301-13806.description: Abstract A major challenge in generating single photons with a single emitter is to excite the emitter while avoiding laser leakage into the collection path. Ideally, any scheme to suppress this leakage should not result in a loss in efficiency of the single-photon source.

arxiv-2304-14680.title: Graph Neural Networks on Factor Graphs for Robust, Fast, and Scalable Linear State Estimation with PMUs Journal: Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks
arxiv-2304-14680.creator: Ognjen Kundacina, Mirsad Cosovic, Dragisa Miskovic, Dejan Vukobratovic
arxiv-2304-14680.description: Abstract As phasor measurement units (PMUs) become more widely used in transmission power systems, a fast state estimation (SE) algorithm that can take advantage of their high sample rates is needed. To accomplish this, we present a method that uses graph neural networks (GNNs) to learn complex bus voltage estimates from PMU voltage and current measurements.

arxiv-2305-05795.title: On the Extremality of the Tensor Product of Quantum Channels
arxiv-2305-05795.creator: James Miller Simeão Toledo da Silva
arxiv-2305-05795.description: Abstract Completely positive and trace preserving (CPT) maps are important for Quantum Information Theory, because they describe a broad class of of transformations of quantum states. There are also two other related classes of maps, the unital completely positive (UCP) maps and the unital completely positive and trace preserving (UCPT) maps.

arxiv-2412-07835.title: Baryonic Ecosystem in Galaxies (BEINGMgII). Host Galaxies of Ultra-strong Mg ii Absorbers in Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam Survey
arxiv-2412-07835.creator: Ravi Joshi, Sarbeswar Das, Michele Fumagalli, Matteo Fossati, Céline Péroux, Reena Chaudhary, Hassen M. Yesuf, Luis C. Ho
arxiv-2412-07835.description: Abstract Context. We study the galaxies hosting ultra-strong Mg ii (USMgII) absorbers at small impact parameters of ∼ \sim 2 ″ 2\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolArcsecond} (5 - 20 kpc), spanning a redshift range of 0.4 ≤ z ≤ 1.7 0.4\ \leq z\leq 1.7 , using deep, high-resolution images from Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Survey and spectra from SDSS survey. Aims.

pmc-11311297.title: Biologically Active Sheep Colostrum for Topical Treatment and Skin Care
pmc-11311297.creator: Kinga Kazimierska, Ilona Szabłowska-Gadomska, Stefan Rudziński, Katarzyna Kośla, Elżbieta Płuciennik, Łukasz Bobak, Aleksandra Zambrowicz, Urszula Kalinowska-Lis, Elzbieta Budzisz, Paulina Mucha
pmc-11311297.description: Colostrum is gaining popularity in cosmetic products. The present study compared the composition and selected biological properties of colostrum from Polish sheep (colostrum 1) and Swiss sheep (colostrum 2), particularly those that can affect healthy or diseased skin. The antioxidant activity of the colostrums was measured using ABTS and DPPH assays.

pmc-11491061.title: Diabetes self-care and its associated factors among type 2 diabetes mellitus with chronic kidney disease patients in the East Coast of Peninsular Malaysia
pmc-11491061.creator: Siti Aisyah Ramli, Nani Draman, Juliawati Muhammad, Siti Suhaila Mohd Yusoff
pmc-11491061.description: IntroductionDiabetes self-care among diabetic patients is crucial as it determines how patients care for their illness in their daily routine for better diabetes control. This study aims to calculate the average score for diabetes self-care among patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease and to identify factors that are associated with this score.

pmc-11535330.title: Optomechanical motions of gold dimer’s spin, rotation and revolution manipulated by bessel beam
pmc-11535330.creator: Chao-Kang Liu, Yun-Cheng Ku, Mao-Kuen Kuo, Jiunn-Woei Liaw
pmc-11535330.description: The optomechanical motion of a gold nanoparticle (GNP) dimer—a pair of optically bound GNPs—in fluid, manipulated by a Bessel beam, is theoretically studied using the multiple multipole (MMP) method. Since a Bessel beam possesses orbital angular momentum (OAM) and spin angular momentum (SAM) simultaneously, complicated rigid-body motions of the dimer can be induced.

pmc-13054947.title: Multi-omic analyses identify molecular targets of Chd7 that contribute to CHARGE syndrome model phenotypes
pmc-13054947.creator: Melody B. Hancock, Dana R. Ruby, Rachael A. Bieler, D. Chris Cole, Kurt C. Marsden
pmc-13054947.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). CHARGE syndrome is a developmental disorder that affects 1 in 10,000 births, and patients exhibit both physical and behavioral characteristics. De novo variants in chromodomain helicase DNA binding protein 7 (CHD7) cause 67% of CHARGE syndrome cases. CHD7 is a DNA-binding chromatin remodeler with thousands of predicted binding sites in the genome, making it challenging to define molecular pathways linking loss of CHD7 to CHARGE syndrome phenotypes.

pmc-13088560.title: Healthcare professionals’ perspectives on a population-based lung cancer screening programme in Flanders: a cross-sectional survey study
pmc-13088560.creator: Lauren Michiels, Caro Verlies, Christophe Dooms, Guido Van Hal, Isabelle Huys
pmc-13088560.description: BackgroundLung cancer is the leading cause of cancer mortality worldwide. In Belgium, this burden is comparable, with high rates of late-stage diagnosis and correspondingly poor outcomes. While low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) screening has proven to be effective in reducing mortality among high-risk groups, Belgium has not yet implemented a population-based screening programme.

pmc-13129016.title: Plasmolyzed yeast cell system for the encapsulation of Pulicaria odora polyphenols: RSM-based process optimization and functional characterization
pmc-13129016.creator: Djamel Eddine Laib, Imen Laib, Hamdi Bendif, Sulaiman A Alsalamah, Tarek H Taha, Fehmi Boufahja, Walid Elfalleh, Stefania Garzoli
pmc-13129016.description: This study focused on optimizing the encapsulation of polyphenols extracted from Pulicaria odora into plasmolyzed Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeast cells using RSM. The polyphenols were obtained via ethanolic maceration, and encapsulation performance was evaluated by varying two key factors: the yeast-to-extract ratio and incubation time. A CCD was employed to model the process and determine optimal conditions.

pmc-13201886.title: Activation of Extraoral Bitter Taste Receptors by Herbs and Spices in the Regulation of Incretin Signaling and Glucose Metabolism
pmc-13201886.creator: Slavko Komarnytsky, Reham Mhawish, Charles Wagner
pmc-13201886.description: Bitter compounds in plants, originally evolved as chemical defenses, are retained within the dry matrices of spices and culinary herbs, where they constitute a chemically diverse pool of potential ligands for bitter taste receptors (TAS2Rs) expressed along the gastrointestinal tract. Beyond their role in oral taste perception, TAS2Rs are increasingly recognized as extraoral chemosensory receptors capable of modulating intestinal physiology.

pmc-13208412.title: Integrating Negative-Pressure Wound Therapy in the Therapeutic Protocol of Extensive Pediatric Burns: Current Practice and Further Treatment Decision Algorithm
pmc-13208412.creator: Doina Iulia Nacea, Dan Mircea Enescu, Mihaela Pertea, Petruța Mitrache, Iulia Mihaela Gavrila, Raluca Tatar
pmc-13208412.description: Background and Objectives: Extensive burns are devastating injuries, especially in children, associating high risk of morbidity and mortality in the absence of immediate and appropriate treatment. Negative-pressure wound therapy (NPWT) has emerged as a versatile tool for the local treatment of burn wounds.

pmc-13232004.title: Negative regulation of human IL-33 in endothelium during allergic airway inflammation
pmc-13232004.creator: Maile K. Hollinger, Chanie L. Howard, Donna C. Decker, Kelly M. Blaine, Ivy Aneas, Emily M. Grayson, Tania E. Velez, Fernando A. Oliveira, Riley T. Hannan, Daniel F. Camacho, Philip A. Verhoef, Cara L. Hrusch, Rebecca S. Griffes, Jeffrey M. Sturek, Marcelo A. Nobrega, Nathan Schoettler, Anne I. Sper
pmc-13232004.description: Lung IL-33 is involved in pathogen defense, barrier homeostasis, and development of allergic responses. We previously identified a 5 kb noncoding region within a GWAS-defined segment that regulates expression of human IL33 (hIL33) but is absent in the murine locus.

pmc-13309427.title: Mining viruses in public databases unveils the diversity within the Deltaflexiviridae family
pmc-13309427.creator: Jhon Eric Alves Fernandes, Tatsuya Nagata, Fernando Lucas Melo

pmc-13327470.title: Global, regional, and national levels and trends in older child, adolescent, and youth (5-24 years) all cause mortality from 1990 to 2024: modelling study
pmc-13327470.creator: Danzhen You, Lucia Hug, Graeme Wilson Fell, Yang Liu, David Sharrow, Patrick Gerland, Bruno Masquelier, Leontine Alkema, Fengqing Chao, Michel Guillot, Thomas Spoorenberg, Bochen Cao, Kathleen Strong, Haidong Wang, Helena Cruz Castanheira, Emi Suzuki
pmc-13327470.description: ObjectiveTo estimate all cause mortality among children, adolescents, and youths aged 5-24 years for 200 countries and areas from 1990 to 2024, to assess mortality levels and trends, and to identify which regions and countries require the greatest investment.DesignDatabase construction of empirical data on mortality, mortality estimation, and assessment of levels and trends.

pmc-13431300.title: Superficial siderosis caused by a tiny dural defect localized by an isodense crossing point on CT myelography: illustrative case
pmc-13431300.creator: Hiromitsu Sasaki, Yasuhiro Takeshima, Ryuta Matsuoka, Ichiro Nakagawa
pmc-13431300.description: BACKGROUNDSuperficial siderosis (SS) is a rare disease characterized by hemosiderin deposition on the brain or spinal surface, potentially leading to cerebellar ataxia, hearing loss, and dementia. For SS caused by spinal dural defects, surgical closure prevents clinical progression; however, precise localization of very small defects remains challenging with conventional imaging modalities.

pmc-13439902.title: L-DOPA influences transferrin-dependent iron release at the blood-brain barrier
pmc-13439902.creator: Rebecka O. Serpa, Kondaiah Palsa, Emily Tufano, Harrison Laukhuff, Vladimir S. Spiegelman, Irina Elcheva, James R. Connor
pmc-13439902.description: Iron dysregulation in the brain is a pathological hallmark of Parkinson’s disease (PD) and contributes to oxidative stress and neurodegeneration. How the blood-brain barrier (BBB), the principal regulator of brain iron homeostasis, is implicated in this process particularly in the context of dopaminergic therapies remains unclear.
